blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Steveston North is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 50 homes sold there: 30 houses, 4 condos, 12 townhomes and 4 duplexes. 30 houses sold in Steveston North with a median price of $1,565,000 (the middle half sold between $1,453,750 and $1,711,250), taking a median of 19 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 17% sold above list.
Steveston North home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

30 houses sold in Steveston North with a median price of $1,565,000 (the middle half sold between $1,453,750 and $1,711,250), taking a median of 19 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 17% sold above list. They had a median $662 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 5,440 square feet. 12 townhomes sold in Steveston North with a median price of $900,000 (the middle half sold between $637,500 and $1,314,250), taking a median of 58 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $658 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median strata fee of $472 a month.

items.t: "Steveston North" is a Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® sub-area name, not a City of Richmond planning-area name. The City plan that covers Steveston is the Steveston Area Plan.
Nearby landmark: Steveston Community Park at 4011 Moncton Street, at No. 1 Road.
The Steveston Area Plan sets a goal of keeping and enhancing the existing single-family character of Steveston.
On June 24, 2024 Council changed zoning on almost 27,000 single-family and duplex lots to allow small-scale multi-unit housing under provincial Bill 44.
For the area described above, the Province extended the rezoning deadline to December 30, 2030; the City had asked for time because of its Steveston sanitary sewer replacement program.

blocks.text: Steveston North: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Steveston Community Park has ball diamonds, tennis courts, a playground, a seasonal waterplay area, an off-leash dog area and a seasonal outdoor pool.
Steveston Community Centre is at 4320 Moncton Street; the City lists a replacement project as underway and the original building as demolished.
The Area Plan names Steveston Village as the main commercial centre.

blocks.text: Steveston North: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: Richmond sits on Fraser River delta islands averaging about 1 m above sea level; the City cites flooding from the river, the ocean and heavy rain.
The City plans to raise dikes from 3.5 m to 4.7 m and designs for a 1-in-500-year flood.
Flood Plain Designation and Protection Bylaw 8204 sets minimum construction levels (the Schedule B figures were not reviewed) and dike setbacks of 7.5 m where a standard dike exists.
The Steveston Island dike concept runs about 3.3 km from Garry Point Park to London Landing, with a multi-decade timeline.
The City says pockets of liquefaction are possible in a major earthquake; not all ground would liquefy.

faq.q: What did homes in Steveston North sell for?
faq.a: 30 houses sold in Steveston North between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,565,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Steveston North?
faq.a: The median was 19 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.1% of the last list price (17% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Steveston North sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 30 houses that sold in Steveston North went for between $1,453,750 and $1,711,250, around a median of $1,565,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Steveston North sell above asking price?
faq.a: 17% of the 30 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.1% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Steveston North?
faq.a: The median year built was 1980 for the 30 houses sold in Steveston North.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Steveston North usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Steveston North had 4 bedrooms, from the 30 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
